TARGET_DOMAIN.description: Apex domain to search for leaked credentials, e.g. 'faradaysec.com'. At least one of TARGET_DOMAIN / TARGET_SUBDOMAIN / MAIL_DOMAIN / URI_PATH must be set per scan.

TARGET_SUBDOMAIN.description: Narrow search to a specific subdomain (LIKE wildcards allowed for the ClickHouse backend, e.g. '%.apps.faradaysec.com').

MAIL_DOMAIN.description: Narrow to leaks whose email address is on this domain (e.g. 'faradaysec.com' catches john@faradaysec.com).

URI_PATH.description: Narrow to leaks referencing a specific URI path (e.g. '/admin').

LIMIT.description: Cap the number of leak records fetched. Default: unlimited (source-dependent).

BAGRE_SOURCE.description: Leak-source backend. Valid: 'intelx' (Intelligence X public API), 'intelx_leaks' (IntelX Leaks-only bucket subset), 'clickhouse' (on-prem leak-DB). Default 'intelx'.

INTELX_API_KEY.description: Intelligence X API key (register at https://intelx.io). Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

INTELX_BASE_URL.description: Intelligence X API base URL. Default 'https://free.intelx.io' (free tier). Paid tenants set 'https://2.intelx.io'.

INTELX_BUCKETS.description: Comma-separated IntelX bucket names to search. Default 'leaks.public.general,leaks.private.general'. See https://intelx.io/tools?tab=buckets for the full list.

INTELX_MAX_FILES.description: Cap on files pulled per bucket. Default 100.

INTELX_MAX_FILE_SIZE.description: Skip individual files larger than this (bytes). Default 52428800 (50 MB).

INTELX_TIMEOUT_S.description: HTTP timeout for IntelX API calls (seconds). Default 60.

CLICKHOUSE_HOST.description: ClickHouse host for the on-prem leak-DB backend (BAGRE_SOURCE=clickhouse). Bare hostname or IP — no scheme. Ignored when BAGRE_SOURCE is intelx / intelx_leaks.

CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE.description: ClickHouse database name for the leak tables.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: ClickHouse username. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: ClickHouse password. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv.

name: bagre
title: Bagre Threat Intelligence
description: Queries Bagre threat-intelligence sources for compromised credentials tied to a target domain. Default source is Intelligence X (intelx.io) — set INTELX_API_KEY as an agent env var; ClickHouse is an optional backend (BAGRE_SOURCE=clickhouse with CLICKHOUSE_* creds). Per-scan, set TARGET_DOMAIN (e.g. 'faradaysec') and optionally narrow with TARGET_SUBDOMAIN (LIKE wildcards), MAIL_DOMAIN, or URI_PATH. Emits one Faraday host per affected IP with the leaked credential as a vulnerability + linked credential record.
